parameters.name: K8sClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster on the data plane.

parameters.name: ReAddPrometheusIntegration
parameters.description: Specifies whether to integrate Managed Service for Prometheus for the cluster on the data plane.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh describe-cluster-grafana --service-mesh-id cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --k8s-cluster-id ce3c25e247da24f3aab9b7edfae830000 --re-add-prometheus-integration false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh DescribeClusterGrafana --region cn-hangzhou --ReAddPrometheusIntegration false --ServiceMeshId cb8963379255149cb98c8686f274x0000 --K8sClusterId ce3c25e247da24f3aab9b7edfae830000
